rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.2, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=0, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-3 INIT_T lever continued, breast-native wdm-wavelet UNCONSTRAINED (DC OFF). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: iter-1 t=0.7 rmse=0.02248; iter-2 t=0.4 rmse=0.01429 (big drop) -- lowering init_t monotonically improves calibrated RMSE by retaining more of the strong 128-view FBP. Both hr=0. (2) Failure mode: with DC-projection OFF the prior term still perturbs the FBP away from the data manifold; less embedding (lower t) = less prior drift. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_init_t 0.4->0.2. (4) HYPOTHESIS: t=0.2 retains still more FBP -> RMSE drops further toward the calibrated FBP floor; tests whether prior-alone can asymptotically REACH but not BEAT baseline (hr->0 from above). If rmse plateaus above baseline, confirms prior-without-DC is net-neutral-to-harmful on sparse breast. (5) BUDGET: <5min. (6) Loop continues.
